nodes.label: arena_v2 001/002 migration never applied to real Supabase project
nodes.rationale: E2E test runs against disposable local pglite, not real Supabase, because branching requires the Pro plan; schema still needs applying via apply_migration before serving real students

nodes.label: pgliteSupabaseAdapter.js E2E test infra
nodes.rationale: partial supabase-js reimplementation covering only the exact query-builder surface arena-v2 repositories use, not general-purpose; NUMERIC columns coerced to match real PostgREST JSON number behavior

nodes.label: av2_portfolio_artifacts vs legacy proof_artifacts consolidation
nodes.rationale: new table created rather than reusing proof_artifacts because that table's FKs point into legacy Arena V1 tables; consolidate only after Arena V1 sunset

nodes.label: av2_xp_ledger vs streak_events.elo_gained naming hazard
nodes.rationale: reusing streak_events.elo_gained for XP would mean writing XP into a column named for ELO, a real bug risk if some future query sums it expecting only ELO; distinct av2_xp_ledger created instead

nodes.label: profiles.is_admin minimal admin model
nodes.rationale: smallest primitive closing the write-gate gap: one boolean column + one requireAdmin middleware, binary admin/not-admin split, no roles/permissions system

nodes.label: Skill Engine / Challenge Progression placeholder logic
nodes.rationale: selection.js implements a minimal default (weak-skill-first, mastery-to-tier mapping, anti-repetition on last 3 instances) behind the function signatures a real Skill Engine module would eventually own

nodes.label: ground_truth_compare submission validator
nodes.rationale: only implemented validator type; other 10 types throw a typed NotImplementedValidatorError rather than a fake always-passes stub, avoiding a scoring-integrity bug

nodes.label: validator field DTO exclusion invariant
nodes.rationale: buildChallengeResponseDto must never include the validator field, since configs carry the grading answer key itself (groundTruthQuery); dto.test.js string-searches for known-secret substrings

nodes.label: reward-engine ELO formula narrower than Arena V1 by design
nodes.rationale: deliberately drops V1's attempt-decay and time-bonus multipliers because Reward Engine only receives {assessment, instance}, matching the literal diagram boundary

nodes.label: Reward-posting failure propagates as an error rather than degrading gracefully
nodes.rationale: deliberate fail-loudly choice rather than silently produce a graded-but-unrewarded state; a more resilient design would use an outbox pattern keyed by assessment_id

nodes.label: applyRewards idempotency guard is check-then-insert, not transactional
nodes.rationale: protects against retry double-reward but not a genuine concurrent double-call race; no UNIQUE(assessment_id) constraint exists today unlike av2_submissions' UNIQUE(instance_id, attempt_number)

nodes.label: FRONTEND_WORKSTATION_REGISTRY (1 of 13 workstations ready)
nodes.rationale: only SqlWorkstation marked ready; the other 12 are honest not_integrated placeholders rendering a 'not wired up yet' notice rather than crashing or faking a render
